title: Hunt bugs in the world readers
plain: Six probes look for wrong answers in the code that reads Minecraft save files and writes build commands. Two are already proven: a block name with a line break sneaks in a second server command, and a height of 300 is sent to a world that stops at 255.
why: The hunt stops after 2 real bugs are fixed, so it cannot run forever.
done_when: Two bugs fixed with the failing output quoted, or six probes run.

title: Hunt bugs in the server drivers
plain: Five probes check the scripts that start the real server, talk to it and stop it: bad replies, repeated settings, a stopped process whose number was reused.
why: Each probe runs first; a probe that shows the right answer is dropped, not counted.
done_when: Two bugs fixed, or five probes run.

title: Hunt bugs in the result scripts
plain: Five probes look at the scripts that turn measurements into sentences and numbers. Three are proven: an unmeasured noise level still prints a next step, an empty benchmark list crashes with no name, flat ground crashes with a maths error.
why: A sentence that claims more than was measured is a bug, even if no crash happens.
done_when: Two bugs fixed, or five probes run.

title: Hunt tests that check nothing
plain: One guard is red on main today: its list of equal worlds is empty, so the check has nothing to check. A plain run of the same file says 0 tests and OK.
why: A test that passes with nothing checked is worse than a missing test.
done_when: Two bugs fixed, or four probes run.

title: Hunt bugs in the website builders
plain: Four probes look at the scripts that build the progress page: duplicate cards, a missing fellow file, a port that cannot be found.
why: One real bug is enough here because the site is small.
done_when: One bug fixed, or four probes run.

title: Hunt bugs in the Rust solver
plain: Five probes try odd maps. Two are proven: a world of 1 by 1 or 0 by 0 cells panics, and a map file with zero width and a height of four billion is accepted.
why: Rust must stay green: all tests and clippy with warnings as errors.
done_when: Two bugs fixed, or five probes run.
